# Macy’s, Inc. Hiring Nationwide to Create a Season of Celebration


September 24, 2026


Download (opens in new window)


*Full- and part-time opportunities available across Macy's, Bloomingdale's, and Bluemercury stores and select supply chain operations in support of our role as a holiday destination.*


**NEW YORK, September 24, 2026 –** Macy's, Inc. today announced plans to hire seasonal colleagues to support Macy's, Bloomingdale's, and Bluemercury stores, as well as distribution and fulfillment centers this holiday season. Opportunities include part-time roles in stores and full- and part-time positions in select supply chain locations. The first of three nationwide hiring events takes place today, September 24.


"Our colleagues give customers a reason to look forward to shopping with us, especially during the holidays," said Danielle Kirgan, Macy's, Inc. chief human resources and corporate affairs officer. "We're inviting seasonal colleagues to join a team that takes pride in helping customers celebrate the moments that matter most. Whether serving customers in stores or helping customers receive what they need, every role helps create the personal connections, thoughtful service, and memorable experiences that make the season special.”


**Benefits and Opportunities to Grow** ****


Macy’s, Inc. offers benefits and resources that support our team’s well-being and financial needs, including:


- Colleague discounts
- Benefits like medical, dental, and vision are available upon hire, based on eligibility
- 401(k) savings
- Earned wage access before scheduled payday
- Employee Assistance Program, including mental health and financial literacy resources


Pay ranges are included in all job postings nationwide, and applicants can view the pay zone and salary range for each role.


For some, a seasonal role can open the door to longer-term career opportunities at Macy's, Inc. beyond the holiday season. The company supports colleagues at every stage of their careers through learning opportunities, skills training and leadership development programs designed to help them grow within the organization.


**How to Apply:** ****


To make the hiring experience faster and more accessible, Macy’s, Inc. offers a simplified online application process. Candidates can apply at any time through[macysJOBS.com](https://ebwh.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_1001/) ,[bloomingdalesJOBS.com](https://ebwh.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_1002/) , and[bluemercuryJOBS.com](https://ebwh.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_4001) . Those applying for Macy’s positions also have the option to submit a recorded interview.


Candidates can also apply in person during the three nationwide hiring events at all Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s, and Bluemercury stores, as well as select supply chain locations. Event times may vary by location:


- Thursday, September 24*
- Thursday, October 22
- Thursday, November 19


**Will include on-the-spot interviews and job offers.*

**About Macy’s, Inc.**


Macy’s, Inc. (NYSE: M) is a trusted source for quality brands through our iconic nameplates – Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s and Bluemercury. Headquartered in New York City, our comprehensive digital and nationwide footprint empowers us to deliver a seamless shopping experience for our customers.
